## Imitation Learning: Direct Emulation of a Motion Plan {.nav-intro}

**Another Approach**: train policy $\pi_{\theta}(a \mid s, \mathcal{X})$ *imitate* motion plan $\mathcal{X}$ from trajectory optimization.

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="50%"}
1. Easy to define reward $R$ for $\mathcal{X}$.
:::

::: {.column width="50%"}
2. (Locally) natural + robust to $\mathcal{X}$
:::

::::
